card.name: Words just before harm or germ terms
card.fires_on: Short linking words or partway-through word pieces right before an expected harm term, such as germs, bacteria, reactions or hepatitis. Seen in health advice and in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Linking word before germs or contaminants
modes.description: A small word like for, on or the that comes just before germs, bacteria or pesticides in hygiene advice.

modes.label: Inside adverse-reaction terms
modes.description: A word piece inside a label term such as fulminant, IAR or immune-mediated, where the rest of the term follows.
